correctness.rationale: For all connected complete multipartite graphs except stars: two colors force R_i=B_i in each part by outside-neighborhood balance and (r-1)(R-B)=0; hence every part is even, and the half-half coloring is sufficient. K4 and K_{2,1,1} require four. For N>=12, 123-periodic colors over part blocks give every outside-part color spread <=2; for degrees >=6, maximum <=d/2, while placing a uniquely large low-degree part last gives direct d=2..5 balance. Inspected verify.py exhaustive count matrices for all profiles N<=11 (183 listed), and independently enumerated all nonstars through N=8, finding 7 two-color, 42 three-color and 2 four-color profiles. Infinite result uses proof, not stress tests.
